title: A は B ほど～ありません
shortExplanation: Express that A is not as much as B; 'not as... as', 'not... to the extent of'.
longExplanation: The は B ほど～ありません grammar point is used to express that A is not as much as B or not to the same extent as B, emphasizing the difference. It can be translated as 'not as... as' or 'not... to the extent of' in English.
formation: A は B ほど Verb/adjective ありません

examples.jp: 今日は昨日ほど寒くありません。
examples.romaji: Kyou wa kinou hodo samuku arimasen.
examples.en: Today is not as cold as yesterday.

examples.jp: 彼は私ほど上手に英語を話せません。
examples.romaji: Kare wa watashi hodo jouzu ni eigo o hanasemasen.
examples.en: He cannot speak English as well as I can.

examples.jp: このレストランはあのレストランほど高くありません。
examples.romaji: Kono resutoran wa ano resutoran hodo takaku arimasen.
examples.en: This restaurant is not as expensive as that restaurant.

examples.jp: 彼女は彼ほど忙しくありません。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa kare hodo isogashiku arimasen.
examples.en: She is not as busy as him.
